thought.text: `.env` created. Let me verify its structure (secrets redacted) and start the Docling image pull in the background:

reasoning_content:
The .env has been created. Let's check it (redacting the secrets), verify that it was parsed correctly, and kick off the docling pull in the background.

I'll start the docling pull in the background.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== .env (secrets redacted) ==="
sed -E 's/(PASSWORD|KEY|SECRET|TOKEN)=.*/\1=<redacted>/' .env
echo "=== start docling pull (background) ==="
nohup bash -c 'docker pull quay.io/docling-project/docling-serve-cpu:latest > /tmp/docling-pull.log 2>&1; echo done > /tmp/docling-pull.done' &
echo "docling pull started"
